common_business_primitives_reused: zero cohort / duplicate / NULL safety contracts
independence.gold_logic_claim: Source and task objectives are newly authored; closed formula/refusal primitives are intentionally shared, not novel independent algorithms or third-party blind authorship.

protocol.blindness: new synthetic development-authored set; not third-party blind, unbiased traffic or a training-data independence claim
protocol.candidate_boundary: read-only frozen product source + worker/gate/Collector only; no Gold, authoring/scorer, assets, signing key, .git, .env or Docker socket
protocol.confidence_intervals: Wilson95 for case proportions; shared sources/datasets violate iid, descriptive only; no population/SLA claim

denominators.NA: do not include non-applicable dimensions; no percentage with zero observed denominator
denominators.citations: returned references for accuracy, required source goals separately for coverage; empty reference set is NA for accuracy
denominators.facts: required host facts; fact verification, RAG completion and business completion separate
denominators.numerical: Gold verified metric goals, including those in partial cases; missing/incorrect result counts as failure
denominators.retrieval: per-query ranked chunk/document/source, then per-case macro; never best-of queries; empty Gold relevance is NA
denominators.strict: all60 planned; report observed/planned, strict/observed and strict/planned separately

protocol.host_information: original goal, reviewed Metric/DocumentGoal, authorized source/version and current scope remain legitimate input; host confirmation is not independent human Gold review
protocol.retry_owner: No SDK or outer retries; original bounded inner Loop/Stop Hook only; unknown never resent
protocol.stop_strategy: B: known ordinary business failures recorded and continue; hard integrity, permission, budget, provider, unknown, TTL or cancellation stop
